name: Lisa Gilroy
bio: Lisa Gilroy is a Canadian actress and comedian.

credits.title: The Sham
credits.overview: A workaholic Brit employed at an upscale New York hotel needs a wife for appearances, so he strikes a deal with a struggling stand-up comic who is desperate for health insurance. Their fake marriage starts as a transaction – but ends in a hilariously unexpected romance.

credits.title: Priyanka! What's My Name?
credits.overview: After hitting a breaking point, drag superstar Priyanka is forced to reevaluate her life, identity, and relationships.

credits.title: Steps
credits.overview: After being blamed for disrupting the Royal Ball with a stolen magic wand, a misunderstood stepsister accidentally turns her sister into a frog and must team up with Cinderella and an unlikely ally to save the kingdom and rewrite their fairytale ending.

credits.title: Young Spencer Goes to School
credits.overview: A day in the life of everyone's favorite demon from Very Important People. He's just a baby!

credits.title: Super Troopers 3
credits.overview: When Farva’s wildly over-the-top Indian engagement to Thorny’s sister spirals into chaos, the Super Troopers must navigate Thorny’s schemes to break up the relationship, while trying to crack a pernicious new drug ring  — all to save the day and maybe the wedding itself.

credits.title: Office Romance
credits.overview: Jackie, President and CEO of Air Cruz, runs a tight ship in her business, including a rigid anti-fraternization policy for all her employees. When a new sexy lawyer begins working for her, that policy becomes very tested.

credits.title: Flame Out
credits.overview: When Grace, a serial people pleaser, double-books her night, she manages to accidentally buy out an entire Diptyque candle party and simultaneously end a friendship.

credits.title: Fine Dining
credits.overview: Arrogant superstar chef Alex Fine pursues the impossible dream of earning a fourth Michelin Star.

credits.title: Stay the Night
credits.overview: A failed work opportunity prompts chronically single Grace to pursue a one night stand with a stranger. Turns out he's an on-the-outs professional athlete in town with a problem of his own. Maybe they can help each other.

credits.title: A Summer Carol
credits.overview: A modern-day Scrooge who hates summer is visited by three ghosts to learn the meaning of fun in the sun in this hilarious retelling of A Christmas Carol.

credits.title: Pathetic Woman
credits.overview: An awkward encounter at work carries two unassuming co-workers into a dreamy holiday weekend. A weekend that inevitably falls to pieces when Andy introduces Katherine to some friends. A surreal portrait of love and how pathetic it renders us.
